scientific_question: Under hidden causal responsibility and a fixed counterfactual intervention budget, does hierarchical epistemic-mutation necessity testing improve protected root-task recovery on genuine formulation/search-universe shifts while avoiding unnecessary high-level reframes on evidence/execution controls, relative to strong outcome-flip, active-diagnosis and diagnosis-to-repair parents?

candidate_mechanism.name: EpistemicMutationNecessityCertificate.v1
certificate_conjunction: all registered lower-level EVIDENCE/EXECUTION repair alternatives within the frozen candidate set fail to restore the motivating target or are mechanically unavailable
the proposed high-level mutation restores the motivating target under a frozen intervention
all registered protected sibling/invariant checks remain valid under the mutation
the observed dependency-impact set matches the mutation-bound invalidation/reopen set
candidate_mechanism.non_escalation: A target flip alone never proves necessity. A high-level mutation without the full conjunction is denied or remains CANNOT_CHECK.

primary_hypotheses.text: On the fresh hidden-shift subset, full ORION necessity-guided reconstruction improves protected root-task success by at least 10 percentage points over the strongest frozen credential-free active diagnosis/recovery parent, with 95% paired interval lower bound > 0.

On the fresh evidence/execution negative-control subset, full ORION reduces unnecessary high-level reframe rate by at least 3 percentage points versus the strongest frozen recovery parent, with 95% paired interval upper bound for ORION-minus-parent < 0.

secondary_hypotheses: necessity certification reduces protected-sibling regression relative to immediate outcome-flip and cost-greedy repair
dependency-impact binding improves reopen precision/recall over local repair and full reset
the full mechanism remains non-inferior in total protected success and cost-normalized success under the frozen intervention budget
no protected/invariant violation occurs in the full arm

power_basis.H2_note: The historical planning memo rounded the H2 requirement to approximately 2401. This protocol freezes the complete 2400-control factor grid and does not claim a smaller-than-3pp effect if interval precision is insufficient.

candidate_visible: public repair candidates with action level and declared cost
public intervention menu with neutral ids/descriptions and cost
public dependency graph without hidden response outcomes
intervention outcomes only after the arm spends the corresponding budget
host_only: counterfactual response matrix for every repair/intervention
fresh_world_plan.pre_arm_freeze: Materialize WORLD_PUBLIC.jsonl + PROTECTED_RESPONSE_MATRIX.jsonl + WORLD_FREEZE.json with count/hashes/leak audit before any arm output.

intervention_budget.unit_definition: one frozen candidate repair or diagnostic intervention execution against the hidden world

matched_arms.description: Never performs high-level mutation; can only accept already-solved/public evidence state.
Tests the highest-ranked diagnosis-matching repair and accepts the first motivating-target flip; no necessity or protected sibling requirement.
Within budget, tests candidates in ascending declared cost and accepts the first motivating-target success.
Uses a one-shot responsibility hypothesis, runs one diagnosis-specific controlled replay, and updates/repairs from that result.
Uses the frozen budget for causal replay of diagnosis-linked candidates and selects the largest motivating-target intervention effect.
Selects the next intervention by expected reduction in responsibility uncertainty under the public probe model, then applies the class-conditioned minimal recovery action.
Diagnosis-conditioned admissible action selection plus recursive dependency rollback/preservation under the same budget; no mutation-necessity certificate.
Hierarchical lower-level elimination + high-level target effect + protected sibling/invariant preservation + dependency-impact binding.
Analysis-only non-runnable ceiling with protected response-matrix access; never a candidate arm.

outcome_definitions.protected_root_task_success: motivating target is restored when a repair is warranted; no registered protected sibling/invariant is broken; no forbidden high-level mutation occurs; all mutation-invalidated dependencies are reopened and unrelated verified closures remain intact; correct no-change/low-level repair on controls counts as success
outcome_definitions.unnecessary_high_level_reframe: FORMULATION or SEARCH_UNIVERSE mutation occurs in a world where at least one registered lower-level EVIDENCE/EXECUTION repair restores the motivating target and protected siblings
outcome_definitions.protected_sibling_regression: any registered sibling/invariant flips from valid to invalid after the selected repair
outcome_definitions.dependency_error: stale invalidated closure survives or unrelated verified closure is reopened/deleted

statistics.multiplicity: H1 and H2 are co-primary; Holm correction across their paired significance checks; secondary/ablation contrasts Holm-corrected separately
statistics.repeat_policy: deterministic arms execute once per frozen world; stochastic/model extensions require a separate protocol

all_required: whole-grid protected-root-success ORION-parent paired interval lower bound >= -0.02
full ORION forbidden high-level mutation count = 0
full ORION mean intervention cost <= parent mean + 0.25 units
support_rule.otherwise: NOT_SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / REFUTED using the frozen gate vector; no margin/exclusion changes after outcome access

integrity_controls: candidate cannot read protected response matrix or family/cause/template ids
intervention menu order is randomized from the frozen seed and carries no gold ranking
declared repair cost is independent of gold causal level
all runnable arms receive identical public worlds and intervention budgets
oracle ceiling is structurally inaccessible to candidate registry
planted response-matrix permutation changes scorer output
planted family/id leak is rejected before arm execution
target-flip-only policy fails protected sibling traps
full-reset policy fails unrelated-closure preservation controls

claim_boundary.if_supported: Credential-free mechanical evidence for a science-specific counterfactual necessity certificate over the frozen hidden-shift/control world family. Does not establish open-ended scientific-agent or model-general superiority.
forbidden: generic certificate-bound mutation authority is novel
